entries.title: 2026 Taiwan Baseball Data Analysis Competition: Should You Steal with a Runner on First and Two Outs? A Decision Analysis
entries.subtitle: On-Field Tactical Analysis Group (in preparation, 4-person team)
highlights: Built a scraper to pull pitch-by-pitch, game-by-game records for analyzing steal decisions with two outs and a runner on first

Studying the break-even success-rate threshold for stealing in CPBL games with two outs and a runner on first only, in innings 1-8, and how that threshold shifts with batting-order position and batter type

Introduces a "retention effect": a failed steal keeps that batter's at-bat held over to start the next inning, correcting a blind spot in traditional RE24 analysis that only looks at the current half-inning
Built a batter decision simulation model to analyze the break-even steal threshold
